import math

def sun_times(lat: float, lon: float, d: datetime.date) -> tuple[datetime.datetime, datetime.datetime]:
    # NOAA Sunrise Equation constants
    # Latitude in degrees
    lat_rad = math.radians(lat)
    # Longitude in degrees

    # Day of the year (1 to 365/366)

    # Hour angle (in degrees) at solar noon

    # Simplified version for hour angle calculation at noon (in degrees):
    hour_angle = 284 * (lat_rad - 0.72 * (day_of_year - 81) / 365.25) * math.cos(solar_declination) / (12 * math.sin(math.radians(360 * (day_of_year - 81))) / 365.25)
